title: Add whisper command for low-priority gossip with context-aware suppression
description: aq whisper: short TTL (60s), severity ceiling medium. Encodes GEACL suppression semantics. Safety-critical updates use announce (aggressive propagation); routine updates use whisper (throttled). Acceptance: aq whisper -c C-1 -f foo.py writes broadcast with ttl=60.
